beats.quote: It's utterly miserable constantly policing screen time.

beats.line: The TV goes back on. Third night running.

beats.me: She keeps putting the TV back on at bedtime. What do I do?

digi: Tonight: sit with her for the last five minutes, then off together. No battle.
Tomorrow: set up her timer. Every screen runs through it, so the timer ends it, not you.
Every night: bedtime is protected. Asking inside it comes to you first.

beats.line: Tonight. The last five minutes, together.
Tomorrow. Her deal, in her own app.
She picks the screen. Her timer ends it.
Inside bedtime, it asks you first.
Five nights on, DiGi checks back.
It ends. She switches it off herself.
Her phone sleeps in the kitchen. Her choice.
